historical_accuracy_notes: Arches on piers carrying a covered channel (specus) with a gentle gradient; where the arcade exceeds ~17 m a second tier is used, the solution seen at the Pont du Gard and Segovia. Span 6.4 m, pier 2.4 m and gradient 0.3 % are estimates for a generic provincial aqueduct.
